posts.body: Hello, I am new to the program and I would like to receive your help with a problem I have. I get very few tilesets when creating a new world, and even if I import new images, they don't appear. I accessed F9 and saw several options: outdoor, indoor and even dungeon, but I can't use them. If I change the properties of the world to any of these options, I can see their elements, but everything I have done on the map is modified. What can I do?

posts.author: ElvenNeko
posts.body:
You need to create new tileset in database tab first. Then add appropriate images to it. Some of tilesets that can be found around are not formatted, and it's a hell of a thing to do without proper knowledge, i spent too much time trying to understand it. What helped me the most was this template -
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...plates-and-guideline.46839/page-6#post-642612
You just create another layer in your editor and place things there so they would fit one or several boxes. Then you disable default layer and save it as png in tileset folder, then add picture to your tileset.
